activity_design_rules: Practice activities should be varied and can include listening, speaking, reading, and writing when the lesson content supports it.
Comprehensive practice and grammar practice should reference HSK and TOCFL item formats, with a preference for practical daily-use situations.
Generated Chinese content must be Simplified Chinese unless Adam explicitly asks otherwise, even when a question style is inspired by TOCFL.
Prefer simple interactive slide/webapp practice when useful: one multiple-choice question per slide, clickable options, success feedback for correct answers, and a try-again prompt for wrong answers.
slide_template_rules: Use Lesson 10 cover slide as the canonical cover template for all future lessons; only replace lesson number, title text, topic chips, and topic image.
Use Lesson 01 divider templates across all lessons by default; only replace page numbers, lesson-specific counts, and images Adam explicitly asks to customize for that lesson.
Reuse Lesson 01 objectives, homework divider, exercise-list structure, dialogue avatar layout, and hanzi-writing layout unless Adam explicitly changes the template.
Hanzi-writing slides must use Lesson 01 HanziWriter stroke animation timing: strokeAnimationSpeed 0.575 and delayBetweenStrokes 360; do not use static characters instead of stroke animation.
image_asset_rules: VP steps 1-8 must write image metadata for every classroom image need: image_role, image_prompt, image_file, image_reuse_from, image_status, and image_semantic_check.
New slide generation starts with blank, correctly sized placeholder image files. Do not generate AI images during initial slide creation.

Generate real images only when Adam asks, then use npm run assets:replace -- --lesson output/book-1/lesson-XX --record V001 --image /path/to/new.png so vocabulary images are resized and the manifest is rebuilt.

For new/regenerated lessons and image edits, run npm run assets:manifest -- output/book-1/lesson-XX and npm run assets:qa -- output/book-1/lesson-XX. Do not run image workflow commands for wording-only slide edits.
